name: Phoenix proxy access control and arbitrary external call

classification.summary: The Phoenix proxy exposed a function that executed a caller-supplied target and calldata with no access control, letting an arbitrary caller move the contract's USDC and leveraged-token holdings out.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: 2021-09-16T13:23:04Z (block 19172145): the phxProxy module pointer at storage slot 14 was last repointed to 0x95620f30263ac0b0b4ffd9b7465838084e89cb84; the main implementation pointer had been repointed to 0x6d68beb09ea7e76d561ea8c4aac34a6611dd9821 two days earlier, at block 19095584

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/phoenix-finance.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.

sources.note: onchain review: Phoenix proxy 0x65BaF1DC6fA0C7E459A36E2E310836B396D1B1de created 2021-08-05T00:43:27Z by 0xdba6252381cc81a533c7afa6972dacb665f7794c, not the attack-tx sender 0x1b288fba50e9c44d8bb269a403dcb21d5f8c6059; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, 579.4 days old. Summing this receipt's ERC-20 Transfer logs gives a net +10,142.67 USDC and +405.04 WETH_BULL_X3 to the attack contract; the DeFiHackLabs 2023 index reports ~$100k for the incident overall, which is the figure recorded here.

delegatecall-target review (callTracer + prestateTracer on the exploit tx, then eth_getStorageAt over [creation block, incident block]): the phxProxy keeps its implementation outside the EIP-1967 slot. The exploit tx DELEGATECALLs 0x65baf1dc...b1de -> 0x6d68beb09ea7e76d561ea8c4aac34a6611dd9821 (three selectors) and -> 0x95620f30263ac0b0b4ffd9b7465838084e89cb84 (selector 0xa9678a18); prestateTracer locates the first in mapping slot 0x116ee98954c8ad885d026f66ba1704d2c92f33e78300484a0108dbee58e9c722 and the second in slot 14. Binary-searching both between the creation block 17630226 and the incident block 40067323: the mapping slot ran 0xff367f14 (deployment) -> 0x6f4fb876 (2021-08-07) -> 0x584ae6bc (2021-08-31) -> 0x9dfee585 (2021-09-08) -> 0x6d68beb09ea7e76d561ea8c4aac34a6611dd9821 at block 19095584, 2021-09-14T11:11:41Z; slot 14 ran 0x44922501 (deployment) -> 0x5870b306 (2021-08-31) -> 0x3e9e2ae9 (2021-09-14) -> 0x95620f30263ac0b0b4ffd9b7465838084e89cb84 at block 19172145, 2021-09-16T13:23:04Z. Both are constant across 60 samples to the incident; the age runs from the later install, 536.9 days rather than 579.4 from deployment
